subject: GCP Marketplace listing orchestration & procurement milestone plan
messages:
From: Samir Gupta <samir@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Interest in GCP listing + procurement next steps

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier this week. Were evaluating a GCP Marketplace listing for Acme Analytics (were a data analytics SaaS) and want to understand the end-to-end flow from listing intake to purchase activation. Key questions from procurement:

- What are the gating documents (seller form, SOC2, tax/billing)?
- How does invoice billing vs. Marketplace billing (GCP passthrough) work for committed spend?
- Typical timeline for listing + activation if were ready to move this month?

Ive looped our procurement alias (procurement@acmeanalytics.com). Can we get a simple milestone plan (high level) and any templates you normally share?

Cheers,
Samir
Head of Cloud Partnerships
Acme Analytics
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interest in GCP listing + procurement next steps

Samir thanks for the clear list. Im attaching a lightweight milestone plan (MAP_v1.xlsx) that summarizes the typical sequence and owner for each step. High level we expect:

1) Intake & seller forms (1-3 business days to validate)
2) Security/compliance checks (SOC2 summary, 3-7 business days review)
3) GCP seller registration & SKU mapping (5-10 days depending on skus)
4) Legal / commercial finalization + DocuSign (1-5 business days once redlines are in)
5) Marketplace activation & billing test (1-2 days)

Notes and immediate asks:
- Can procurement confirm preferred billing (GCP Marketplace billing vs. invoiced purchase order)? That dictates the onboarding track.
- Ive attached the seller intake we need filled (GCP_SellerForm.pdf). If you prefer, we can run a 30-minute intake call.

Attaching: MAP_v1.xlsx, GCP_SellerForm.pdf

Best,
Irene Choi
Partner Ops | Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interest in GCP listing + procurement next steps

Adding a few procurement-facing details from our side:

- Required security evidence: short SOC2 summary (we provided SOC2-Summary.pdf) and a URL to our audit contact. Full report can be shared under NDA if needed.
- Billing models: if you want GCP Marketplace billing (Google invoices), we need seller registration completed and SKU mapping confirmed; invoiced PO is supported via our commercial portal but requires a signed MSA + billing contact + net terms set up (10-15 days typical).
- For committed/reserved discounts: we recommend locking SKU pricing in the contract and using the Dedicated/Private options for reserved capacity, if applicable.

Proposed immediate milestone (updates on MAP_v1):
- 24 Aug: procurement confirms billing preference + uploads signed seller form
- 25-27 Aug: security review + SOC2 summary acknowledged
- 28-31 Aug: SKU mapping and draft DocuSign sent to legal
- Early Sep: activation and billing test

Marissa: can you confirm whether we have a prebuilt template for Marketplace PO terms we can share?

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of GTM Ops | Redwood Inference

On the timeline: can you send the SKU mapping template and confirm how well validate consumption on the test invoice? Also, wed like a single milestone doc that we can attach to our internal purchase request.
